sources.note: SISTER LECT Weme; the template of the 'Esquisse de la tonologie synchronique' series (consonants, syllable structures, method, verb tones, noun tones, analysis, conclusion). 'accent' occurs only as diacritic names (p. 66). No stress/accent section -- suggests the Ayizo article likely has none either, but unverified.

sources.citation: Muysken, Pieter & Norval Smith (eds.). 2014. Surviving the Middle Passage: The West Africa-Surinam Sprachbund (TiLSM 275). Berlin: De Gruyter Mouton. OAPEN open access.
sources.note: Gbe migration/noun-class-prefix chapter mentions Ayizo (Allada, Glo) and 'Emigrant Ayizo' lects (Toli): prefix vowels only. All 'stress' hits concern Sranan/Jamaican/English. Nothing on Ayizo prosody.

sources.citation: Kluge, Angela. 2011. A sociolinguistic survey of the Gbe language communities of Benin and Togo: Gbe language family overview. SIL ESR 2011-012; Kluge 2007 LD&C 1(2); Kluge 2008 SIL ESR 2008-023.
sources.note: Classification/lexicostatistics; Ayizo sampled as a Phla-Phera/Fon-cluster variety; 'stress' only as Kruskal MDS stress. Nothing on word stress.

sources.citation: Gbéto, Flavien. 2006. La participation des consonnes comme unités porteuses de ton en kotafon, dialecte gbe du Sud-Bénin. Journal of West African Languages 33(2): 87-107.
sources.note: SISTER LECT Kotafon, same author/year/template; cites the Ayizo JALL paper. Two underlying tones H and B, derived M/BH/HB/MH/HM; voiceless obstruents insert H. Only accent wording: intro p. 88 'une règle qui assigne la mélodie tonale HB, interprétation d'un phénomène accentuel en œuvre au niveau du redoublement des radicaux verbaux CcV dont C est voisée' and sec. 5.3 (replacive tone melody in verbal reduplication). No word-stress statement; nothing on Ayizo beyond the citation.

sources.citation: Gbéto, Flavien. 2004. Tonologie synchronique du tɔfingbe du village lacustre de Ganvié, dialecte gbe du Sud-Bénin. JWAL 31(2): 27-46.
sources.note: SISTER LECT Tofin, same template; 'accent' only as diacritic names; no word-stress statement (per sibling audit and grep).

fr: notes give two base tones H and B with derived M, BH, HB, MH, HM (wording matches Gbeto's abstracts) and a bibliography (Gbeto 2006 JALL; Agossou-Voyèmè local Cotonou publications; Capo; Kluge); en: orthographic tone marking only. Nothing on accent/stress.
